callScript:
Hi Dr. D.K. Singh Dental Clinic team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke dental clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? 

Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp patient booking, mobile-first speed, and service showcases for your Fraser Road location. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? 

Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact treatments, actual clinic photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
